description: Add ZH/EN bilingual support to classes, sessions, terms page, participant QR page, WhatsApp messages, and admin portal

userStories.title: Schema migration — rename name/location to name_zh/location_zh, add name_en/location_en/end_time
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to migrate the Convex schema so classes have bilingual names and sessions have bilingual locations and end times.
acceptanceCriteria: In convex/schema.ts: rename classes.name → name_zh (string required), add name_en (optional string)
In convex/schema.ts: rename sessions.location → location_zh (string required), add location_en (optional string), add end_time (optional string)
Write a Convex migration mutation in convex/migrations.ts (or similar) that copies existing name → name_zh and location → location_zh for all records

Update all Convex query/mutation files that read or write name or location: convex/adminClasses.ts, convex/adminSessions.ts, convex/homepage.ts, convex/participants.ts, convex/purchaseConfirmation.ts, convex/participantLinks.ts, convex/seed.ts, convex/csvImport.ts, convex/adminParticipants.ts — replace name with name_zh, location with location_zh throughout
Update all return type validators (v.object) in Convex files to use name_zh/location_zh instead of name/location
npx convex deploy --yes runs without errors (test with dry-run if needed)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: IMPORTANT: This is a schema rename, not an add. Use Convex's patching approach: add new fields alongside old fields first, then remove old. Since this is a breaking rename, the safest approach is: (1) add name_zh as optional with default = name, (2) run migration, (3) make name_zh required and remove name. But in a single migration step: just add name_zh/location_zh as optional fields copying from name/location in the schema, write a migration mutation, and update all code to use new names. The old fields name and location should be removed from schema once migration is written. Files to update: convex/schema.ts, convex/adminClasses.ts, convex/adminSessions.ts, convex/homepage.ts, convex/participants.ts, convex/purchaseConfirmation.ts, convex/participantLinks.ts, convex/seed.ts. Also update all Next.js API routes and page data types that reference class_name or location.
